name: glypican 3

function.text: GPC3 encodes glypican-3 [Cleaved into: Glypican-3 alpha subunit; Glypican-3 beta subunit]. Annotated molecular activities include peptidyl-dipeptidase inhibitor activity. It participates in cell migration and anatomical structure morphogenesis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Simpson-Golabi-Behmel syndrome (x-linked); Simpson-Golabi-Behmel syndrome type 1 (x-linked).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

function.text: GPC3 encodes glypican-3. Based in part on similarity, it negatively regulates the hedgehog signaling pathway when attached via the GPI-anchor to the cell surface by competing with the hedgehog receptor PTC1 for binding to hedgehog proteins. It positively regulates the canonical Wnt signaling pathway by binding to the Wnt receptor Frizzled and stimulating the binding of the Frizzled receptor to Wnt ligands. It positively regulates the non-canonical Wnt signaling pathway.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Simpson-Golabi-Behmel syndrome (x-linked); Simpson-Golabi-Behmel syndrome type 1 (x-linked).
